content_metadata.description: An Asian man attempts to fix his modem, which despite a strong signal, shows no internet connectivity. The video captures his step-by-step troubleshooting process and eventual success.

narrativeProgression.description: The internet light starts blinking after the second power cycle.
The man decides to perform a third power cycle to be sure.
He demonstrates unplugging the power adapter for the third time.
He demonstrates plugging the power adapter back in for the third time.
He reveals that the internet light is now blinking consistently.
